# The paths whose change runs a pull request's tests on Windows (decision 70): CI's
# `platforms` job and tools/check-windows-paths.sh both read this file.
#
# One glob a line, matched as git's glob pathspecs, from the repository's root: `*` stays
# within a folder, `**` crosses folders. A `#` starts a comment.
#
# Wider than the files with a platform cfg: Windows fails in code without one too, on
# Unix paths in tests and on CR LF in fixtures. tools/check-windows-paths.sh fails when
# a file with a platform cfg is not covered here.

# The window's platform code, and the packages.
crates/display/**
packaging/**

# Paths, files and folders.

crates/base/src/folders.rs
crates/base/src/settings/**

crates/engine/src/sidecar.rs
crates/engine/src/names.rs
crates/engine/src/export_preview.rs
crates/engine/src/export_job.rs
crates/app/build.rs
crates/app/src/main.rs
crates/app/src/dialogs.rs
crates/app/src/dialog_host.rs
crates/app/src/dialog_host/**
crates/app/src/paths.rs
crates/app/src/folder.rs
crates/app/tests/packaging.rs

# Other files with a platform cfg.
crates/app/src/jobs.rs
crates/app/src/jobs/**
crates/app/src/menus.rs
